source_statements.source_statement: Create or continue an active Codex goal, use a separate clean worktree for the OneTime UI shell repair, register raw intake and requirements first, and run the execution CLI.
Repair the OneTime Operations shell globally across Rabbi workspace routes so the UI looks normal, readable, scoped, and usable.
Fix the toolbar and tab hierarchy: one compact header, one clean module rail, no duplicate workspace chip, no dominant Ask/Search/date/New Message layer, and mobile tabs scroll instead of wrapping.
Fix the One Time dashboard overview route by replacing the giant empty dark panel and floating Command Center card with useful readable dashboard cards.
Fix the communications overview route with the specified tab rail, no duplicate right-side channel count cards, demoted import logs, separate Email and WhatsApp, and gated New Message.
Normalize One Time buttons and action states and keep unsafe send, payment, DNS, Railway, Zoom, Vimeo, and external actions visually gated.
Scope and repair One Time brand CSS so brand color remains present without globally breaking BNA Operations, contrast, rails, card sizing, or layout.
Audit dashboard, communications, members, program, tasks, automations, integrations, reporting, and other visible One Time modules for sane shell/header/tab/content behavior.
Preserve workspace/data separation: Rabbi routes stay scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class; no BNA private data, raw contact data, secrets, or GHL runtime.
Capture before/after evidence, run focused tests/watchdogs/secrets audit/run validation, and deploy/live-smoke app-visible work or record an exact blocker.
Do not send email, WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram, create Stripe checkout, charge money, mutate DNS/Railway, write external CRM, import contacts, commit secrets, or commit raw private data.
